meta.description: Agent / web-research curated SEA telecom intel. Merged into tele column at fetch time.

items.title: Vietnam eyes new 5G deals with Chinese tech firms despite US warnings
items.snippet: Mobifone in talks with Huawei; Viettel and VNPT signed 5G supply contracts with ZTE and Huawei. Ericsson and Nokia still supply core network.

items.title: Huawei and ZTE strengthen presence in Vietnam with new 5G network deal wins
items.snippet: Huawei consortium ~$23M 5G equipment contract; Viettel targeting 20,000 new 5G base stations in 2025. 11,000+ stations deployed nationwide.

items.title: EU warns Vietnam: Chinese 5G vendors may deter foreign investment
items.snippet: Ericsson and Nokia on core; Huawei and ZTE winning RAN/antenna contracts. EU Commissioner Sikela: 5G is the new battlefield for trusted vendors.

items.title: Huawei expands Vietnam footprint through energy, AI, and 5G partnerships
items.snippet: Partnerships spanning digital energy, AI, telecom infrastructure and industrial digitalization in Vietnam.

items.title: Cambodia launches 5G as all three mobile operators switch on networks
items.snippet: Cellcard, Metfone and Smart launched 5G from Jan 2026. Phased rollout from Phnom Penh and 14 provinces.

items.title: 1,500 5G base stations deployed in Cambodia's 5G race so far
items.snippet: Smart Axiata 674, Metfone (Viettel) 531, Cellcard 289 stations. Ministry accelerating mobile and FWA rollout.

items.title: Comin Asia and Nokia build sovereign AI infrastructure across Southeast Asia
items.snippet: AI-ready data centres planned for Cambodia and Laos; Nokia partnership for regional sovereign AI infrastructure.
